sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT on top of the robot (light from above, dim only inside a tunnel)

control_flow: Forever: call followLine, which does: if the light above the left sensor is below 50 %, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line from the start, through its curves, all the way to the green goal at its end, without leaving it.

decision_points.condition: the light above the left light sensor is below 50 %

branches.outcome: the light is dim (below 50 %): it curves left
the light is bright (50 % or more): it curves right

scenarios.coded_response: The light above is bright (100 %), so it curves right, away from the line.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line in bright light, with a green goal at the line's end.
scenarios.trigger: The program reads the light above it and steers.
scenarios.title: Follows the line to the goal
assumptions: The green goal is at the end of the line.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line through its curves all the way to the green goal, without leaving it.

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left, continuously, as long as the light stays dim.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot is inside a tunnel, so the light above it is dim (below 50 %).
scenarios.trigger: It reads the dim light and takes the other branch.
scenarios.title: In dim light in a tunnel
assumptions: You didn't say what the robot should do in dim light; the program only curves left.

uncertainties: You said follow the black line, but the program reads the light sensor on top of the robot, not the line tracker: the black line doesn't change what it reads.
The light above is dim only inside a tunnel, which you didn't mention.
On the open floor the light reads 100 %, so the robot always curves right there and never follows the line.

outcomes.words: the condition doesn't hold: the else part runs
planned: Follows the line to the goal

worlds.name: A line with a bend to the goal

tests.name: Follows the line to the goal
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts on the line in bright light, when the program runs, then it follows the line through the bend and reaches Goal 1 at its end without leaving the line.

equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: start A on the line in the open, far from any tunnel, so the light above reads 100 %

expected_results: It follows the line through the bend and reaches Goal 1 at the line's end.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1 at the end of the line.

assumptions: The green goal is at the end of the line.
